ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (26) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Отец» (otets, 'father') and «сын божий» (syn bozhiy, 'son of God') keep the source's lowercase, and the Gospel words (John 4:21–24, 4:15) and Farrar's echo of Acts 17:28 are translated from the Russian, not taken from an English Bible. «Начало жизни» (nachalo zhizni) is 'the source of life'; Farrar's italics (*eternal*, *future*, *invisible*) are kept, and «Индийская Вамана Пурана» (Indiyskaya Vamana Purana) is 'The Indian Vamana Purana.'
